title: Barclay Friends opens its doors for an August open house
summary: The West Chester senior living community hosts an open house Aug. 22 and 23 from 9 AM to noon at 700 N. Franklin Street. Visitors can tour the campus and learn about personal care, memory care, residential living and skilled nursing options.

title: West Chester drugmaker Verrica lands up to $27.5M in new financing
summary: Verrica Pharmaceuticals secured a credit facility of up to $27.5 million from an entity controlled by board chairman Paul Manning, with $12.5 million available immediately. The company plans to use it to grow its only FDA-approved product.

title: Former West Chester University lineman signs with the Eagles
summary: David Blay Jr., a zero-star recruit who walked on at Division II West Chester, signed with the Philadelphia Eagles this week ahead of their preseason opener. He recorded 38 tackles and five sacks for the Golden Rams in 2022.

title: Spring House at Brandywine apartments sell for $66.3 million
summary: The 212-unit complex on Reisling Lane off Route 202 was purchased by Atlanta-based Invesco from Coastal Ridge Real Estate, working out to roughly $312,500 per unit. That is 72 percent above what the seller paid in 2019.

title: A 200-year-old dairy barn holds one of the country's biggest bookstores
summary: Baldwin's Book Barn outside West Chester packs more than 300,000 rare and used books across five floors and 25,000 square feet. The 1822 barn is still run by 91-year-old Carol Rauch and also carries manuscripts, maps and prints.

title: QVC's longest-running host says he'll sign off in December
summary: Rick Domeier announced his retirement from the West Chester shopping network during his annual Christmas in July special, capping 32 years on air. He plans to work through the end of December.

title: Gay Street tattoo artist reclaims a world record after 76 hours in the chair
summary: Brannan Clift of Liberty Bell Tattoo & Piercing at 124 E. Gay Street tattooed one client for 76 straight hours, beating a mark set by an Italian team. Clift, who runs the shop as a faith-based studio, required that the artwork be religious in subject.

title: QVC on-air hosts vote to join SAG-AFTRA
summary: Roughly 80 percent of hosts across QVC, HSN and the company's digital channel backed unionizing in a labor board election tallied July 23. Organizers pointed to pay, job security and the use of hosts' likenesses in AI as driving concerns.
